forum.title: STM32H743: does this MCU support MIPI LCD?
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@Robinson2007 and welcome to the ST community.

The answer is No. It supports only LTDC interface with no MIPI-DSI host.

If you need a STM32H7 with MIPI interface. You need to select one of the dual core Graphical line products: STM32H74**7** or STM32H75**7**.
